title: AI testing transport failures must not masquerade as behavior failures
symptom: AI test status reported every release-blocker case as failed when all configured providers returned API errors, including insufficient balance.
root_cause: The status builder had no failure-domain distinction, so provider transport/configuration failures were collapsed into behavioral case failures.
fix: Classify stale AI test reports and all-provider API failures separately with failure_domain, transport_blocked, transport_block_reason, and provider_diagnostics fields.
validation: factoryctl ai-test-status exposes stale and provider diagnostics instead of only behavioral failure labels
operator_action: When failure_domain is provider_transport, repair provider balance, API routing, or model configuration before tuning prompts or case expectations.
